description: OpenClaw affected by iMessage remote attachment SCP hardening (strict host-key checks and remoteHost validation)
how_introduced: This commit introduced the vulnerable feature end-to-end. In `src/auto-reply/reply/stage-sandbox-media.ts` it created `scpFile()` with `StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new` and passed `${remoteHost}:${remotePath}` directly to `scp` without a `--` end-of-options separator; in `src/imessage/monitor/monitor-provider.ts` it added `remoteHost` resolution from config and from `detectRemoteHostFromCliPath()`, then propagated that value as `MediaRemoteHost`. Pickaxe searches for `StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new`, ```${remoteHost}:${remotePath}```, `let remoteHost = imessageCfg.remoteHost;`, `remoteHost?: string;`, and `remoteHost: z.string().optional(),` all trace back to this commit as the first introduction, and the pre-7a9 file versions had no remote-attachment/SCP logic at all.

bug_commits.author: Tyler Yust
bug_commits.message: iMessage: Add remote attachment support for VM/SSH deployments
